components.name: Download Link
components.description: A file download as a link: Groovy Green highlighter swipes in behind the label on hover.
components.html: SVG
components.css: .ds-download { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 4px; color: #17132F; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; } .ds-download > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-download svg { overflow: visible; } .ds-download::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 18%; bottom: 12%; z-index: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: #00FF85; transform: scaleX(0) skewX(-12deg); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-download-arrow { transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-download:hover::before, .ds-download:focus-visible::before { transform: scaleX(1) skewX(-12deg); } .ds-download:hover .ds-download-arrow { transform: translateY(4px); } .ds-download:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF, 0 0 0 4px #17132F; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: 32px pill filter with a light border; selected fills Midnight.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(23, 19, 47, 0.2); background: #FFFFFF; color: #17132F; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms, border-color 200ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #17132F; } .ds-chip-on, .ds-chip-on:hover { border-color: #17132F; background: #17132F; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF, 0 0 0 4px #17132F; }

narrative.overview:
The hub is a well-run reference desk. Everything is labeled, shelved where you expect it, and handed over in seconds. People arrive from a Slack link or the search box with one need (a logo, a hex, a voice rule, a Claude skill) and the system's job is to get out of the way between them and the answer. Pages are calm and light; the desk itself (masthead, page headers) is Midnight; Groovy Green is the spark that tells you where you are and what you can take.

The mood is precise, quick, and quietly electric. Density is comfortable rather than airy: compact rows, two button sizes, 13 to 16px working type, with display weight reserved for page and chapter openers. Components are tactile and confident. Actions answer a hover or a click with a decisive change: a full Midnight inversion, a green highlighter swipe, a check that pops in. Because people copy what they see here, the hub follows the brand's own rules to the letter: Figtree everywhere, the two-greens contrast rule, Midnight labels on green.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight chrome (masthead, page headers) framing a light canvas (#F5F5F8) with white surfaces
One surface radius (8px); pills for every button
Flat at rest; shadows only on floating layers
Groovy Green as a spark, not a field, on light pages
Decisive, tactile state changes: inversions, highlighter swipes, pop-in checks
Compact, scannable directories with search and filters first

rules.name: The Two Greens Rule
rules.body: Groovy Green (#00FF85) lives on dark backgrounds only. On light, green is #008847. Never set #00FF85 as text or a fill on white, and label each green for contrast: Midnight on Groovy Green, white on #008847.

rules.name: The Spark Rule
rules.body: On a light page, green marks position and possession (active item, focus, download, saved) and covers a small fraction of the screen. Large green fields belong to brand specimens, not to UI.

rules.name: The Statement Rule
rules.body: Display and headline type are statements: no trailing periods, text-wrap: balance. Paragraphs use text-wrap: pretty and fill the measure.

rules.name: The Measure-Is-Rendered Rule
rules.body: Figtree's ch overstates line length by about 30%. Verify line length from rendered line boxes before changing --measure.

rules.name: The Search-First Rule
rules.body: On any page whose job is finding, the search field and filters come before the content they filter.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Cards and rows never carry a resting shadow. If something needs to read as separate, give it a white surface and a hairline, not a shadow.

rules.name: The One Radius Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are 8px, actions are pills. A third radius needs a reason.

dos: Do use #008847 for any green on light surfaces and #00FF85 only on Midnight.
Do put Midnight labels on green fills.
Do keep buttons to two sizes: 40px for the main action, 32px for repeated controls.
Do present file downloads as links with the green highlighter, not as buttons.
Do answer every interaction with a decisive state change: a full inversion, the highlighter, a check.
Do give every control a visible keyboard focus ring.
Do open finding pages with search and filters before the content.
donts: Don't set #00FF85 as text or a fill on white, or put white text on any green.
Don't add resting shadows to cards or rows.
Don't introduce a radius other than 8px for surfaces or full pills for actions.
Don't end display or headline type with a period.
Don't use any typeface other than Figtree.
Don't ship placeholder or "Coming soon" surfaces; show real content or a WIP tag.
